entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَنَا وَزِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ بِالرَّقَّةِ، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ فَأَقَامَنِي عَلَى رَجُلٍ بِالرَّقَّةِ، فَقَالَ: زَعَمَ هَذَا، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ وَحْدَهُ، فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُعِيدَ» وَاسْمُهُ وَابِصَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Husayn b. 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Hilal b. Yasaf, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ziyad b. Abi al-Ja'd and I were in al-Raqqa. Ziyad took my hand and brought me to a man there, saying: “This man reports that the Messenger of God ﷺ saw someone praying alone behind the row, and the Prophet ﷺ ordered him to repeat his prayer.” His name was Wabisa b. Ma'bad.

sections.title_en: Two reports of Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr al-Ḥaḍramī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثَا وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَاصِمُ بْنُ كُلَيْبٍ الْجَرْمِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ وَائِلَ بْنَ حُجْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ وَبَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ، وَرَأَيْتُهُ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَضْجَعَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى وَنَصَبَ الْيُمْنَى، وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى، وَبَسَطَهَا، وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُمْنَى، وَقَبَضَ ثِنْتَيْنِ وَحَلَّقَ حَلَقَةً وَدَعَا هَكَذَا» وَنَصَبَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ السَّبَّابَةَ، قَالَ وَائِلٌ: «ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُمْ فِي الشِّتَاءِ فَرَأَيْتُهُمْ يَرْفَعُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي الْبَرَانِسِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: 'Asim b. Kulayb al-Jarmi narrated to us, saying: I heard my father say: I heard Wa'il b. Hujr al-Hadrami say:
entries.matn_en: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ raise his hands when he began the prayer, when he bowed, and after raising his head from bowing. I saw him when sitting in prayer lay his left leg on its side and set his right leg upright; he placed his left hand flat on his left thigh and his right hand on his right thigh, bent two fingers, formed a circle [with the others], and supplicated like this.” Al-Humaydi raised his index finger. Wa'il said: “Then I came to them in winter and saw them raising their hands inside their hooded cloaks.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِدَلْوٍ مِنْ زَمْزَمَ فَشَرِبَ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ، وَمَضْمَضَ، ثُمَّ مَجَّهُ فِي الدَّلْوِ مِسِكًا، أَوْ قَالَ أَطْيَبَ مِنَ الْمِسْكِ، وَاسْتَنْثَرَ خَارِجًا مِنَ الدَّلْوِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Jabbar b. Wa'il, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A bucket of Zamzam water was brought to the Prophet ﷺ. He drank, then performed ablution and rinsed his mouth, then spat the water back into the bucket; it was musk—or he said, more fragrant than musk. He blew water out of his nose outside the bucket.”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mughaffal ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَيُّوبُ السِّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَذَفَ قَرَابَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ عِنْدَهُ، فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، وَقَالَ: " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهَا، وَقَالَ: إِنَّهَا لَا تَصِيدُ صَيْدًا، وَلَا تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا، وَإِنَّهَا تَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ، وَتَكْسَرُ السِّنَّ " فَعَادَ فَخَذَفَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ مُغَفَّلٍ: «أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْهَا وَتَعُودُ، لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: A relative of 'Abd Allah b. Mughaffal flicked pebbles while in his presence. He forbade him, saying: “The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade it, saying that it does not bring down game or injure an enemy, but it can put out an eye and break a tooth.” The man did it again, and Ibn Mughaffal said to him: “I tell you from the Messenger of God ﷺ that he forbade it, and you do it again? I shall never speak to you again.”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAṭiyya al-Quraẓī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَطِيَّةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَطِيَّةَ الْقُرَظِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «كُنْتُ يَوْمَ حَكَمَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فِي بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ غُلَامًا، فَنَظَرُوا إِلَى مُؤْتَزَرِي، فَلَمْ يَجِدُونِي أَنْبَتُّ، فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr narrated to us, saying: I heard 'Atiyya al-Qurazi say:
entries.matn_en: “On the day when Sa'd b. Mu'adh judged Banu Qurayza, I was a boy. They examined what was beneath my waist-wrapper and found that I had not yet grown pubic hair; and here I am among you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا فِي مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «كُنْتُ يَوْمَ حَكَمَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فِي بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ غُلَامًا، فَشَكُّوا فِي، فَنَظَرُوا إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا الْمَواسِيَّ جَرَتْ عَلَيَّ فَاسْتُبْقِيتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Najih narrated to us, from Mujahid, who said: I heard a man in the mosque of Kufa say:
entries.matn_en: “On the day when Sa'd b. Mu'adh judged Banu Qurayza, I was a boy. They were uncertain about me, so they examined me and found that the razors had not yet been applied to me [I had not reached puberty]; therefore I was spared.”

sections.title_en: Reports of Abū Juḥayfa Wahb al-Suwāʾī ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ وَهْبٍ السُّوَائِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَشَيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: " هَلْ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ يُشْبِهُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Khalid narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I walked with Abu Juhayfa to the Friday prayer and asked him: “Did you see the Messenger of God ﷺ?” He said: “Yes, and al-Hasan b. 'Ali resembled him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، وَمِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا آكُلُ مُتَّكِئًا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Zakariyya b. Abi Za'ida and Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Ali b. al-Aqmar, from Abu Juhayfa, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “I do not eat while reclining.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ مِغْوَلٍ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ عَوْنَ بْنَ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ بِلَالٌ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: فَابْتَدَرَهُ النَّاسُ فَأَصَبْتُ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا وَلَمْ آلُ، قَالَ: وَنَصَبَ بِلَالٌ عَنَزَةً، «فَصَلَّى إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنَّ الْكَلْبَ، وَالْمَرْأَةَ، وَالْحِمَارَ، يَمُرُّونَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard Malik b. Mighwal say: I heard 'Awn b. Abi Juhayfa narrate from his father, who said: Bilal came out with some of the leftover water from the ablution of the Messenger of God ﷺ. The people rushed to it and I obtained some of it, exerting myself to do so. Bilal then planted a short spear in the ground, and the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed facing it while a dog, a woman, and a donkey passed in front of him.

sections.title_en: Report of Dukayn ibn Saʿīd al-Muzanī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ دُكَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ قَيْسًا، يَقُولُ: ثني دُكَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْمُزَنِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَرْبَعِمِائَةِ رَاكِبٍ نَسْأَلُهُ الطَّعَامَ، فَقَالَ: «يَا عُمْرُ اذْهَبْ فَأَطْعِمْهُمْ، وَأَعْطِهِمْ» ، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا عِنْدِي إِلَّا آصِعٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ مَا تَقِيظُ عِيَالِي، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: اسْمَعْ وَأَطِعْ، فَقَالَ عُمْرُ: سَمْعٌ وَطَاعَةٌ، قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقَ عُمَرُ حَتَّى أَتَى عِلْيَةً لَهُ، فَأَخْرَجَ مِفْتَاحًا مِنْ حُجُزَتِهِ فَفَتَحَهَا، فَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ: ادْخُلُوا فَدَخَلُوا، وَكُنْتُ آخِرَ الْقَوْمِ دُخُولًا، فَأَخَذْتُ وَأَخَذْتُ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا مِثْلُ الْفَصِيلِ مِنَ التَّمْرِ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Khalid narrated to us, saying: I heard Qays say: Dukayn b. Sa'id al-Muzani told me:
entries.matn_en: “We came to the Messenger of God ﷺ, four hundred riders, asking him for food. He said: ‘'Umar, go and feed them and give them supplies.’ 'Umar said: ‘Messenger of God, I have only a few sa's of dates, barely enough to sustain my family through the summer.’ Abu Bakr said: ‘Hear and obey.’ 'Umar replied: ‘I hear and obey.’ He went to an upper room belonging to him, took a key from his waist-band, opened it, and said to the men: ‘Enter.’ They entered, and I was the last. I took and took, and then I turned around and saw there was still a pile of dates as large as a young camel.”

sections.title_en: Two reports of ʿAdī ibn ʿUmayra al-Kindī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثَا عَدِيِّ بْنِ عُمَيْرَةَ الْكِنْدِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ قَيْسًا، يَقُولُ: حَدَّثَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ عُمَيْرَةَ الْكِنْدِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَنِ اسْتَعْمَلْنَاهُ مِنْكُمْ عَلَى عَمَلٍ فَلْيَأَتِ بِقَلِيلِهِ وَكَثِيرِهِ، فَمَنْ كَتَمَنَا خَيْطًا أَوْ مِخْيَطًا فَمَا سِوَاهُ، فَهُوَ غُلُولٌ يَأْتِي بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ» ، فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ أَسْوَدُ قَصِيرٌ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اقْبَلْ مِنِّي عَمَلَكَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَمَا ذَاكَ؟» ، قَالَ: الَّذِي قُلتَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَأَنَا أَقُولُ الْآنَ مَنِ اسْتَعْمَلْنَاهُ مِنْكُمْ عَلَى عَمَلٍ فَلْيَأْتِ بِقَلِيلِهِ وَكَثِيرِهِ، فَمَا أُوتِيَ مِنْهُ أَخَذَ، وَمَا نُهِيَ عَنْهُ انْتَهَى»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Isma'il narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard Qays say: 'Adi b. 'Umayra al-Kindi narrated to me, saying: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “People, whoever we appoint among you to a task must bring all of its proceeds, great and small. Whoever conceals from us a thread, a needle, or anything more is committing misappropriation (ghulul), and will bring it on the Day of Resurrection.” A short, dark-skinned man of the Helpers stood up before him—I can almost see him—and said: “Messenger of God, take back your assignment from me.” The Messenger of God ﷺ asked: “Why?” He replied: “Because of what you have said.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “I say it now again: Whoever we appoint to a task must bring all of it, great and small; whatever is given to him [lawfully] he may take, and whatever he is forbidden he must refrain from.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 142⦘ : اسْتَعْمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ: «اتَّقِ يَا أَبَا الْوَلِيدِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِبَعِيرٍ تَحْمِلُهُ عَلَى رَقَبَتِكَ لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، أَوْ بَقَرَةٌ لَهَا خُوارٌ، أَوْ شَاةٌ لَهَا ثُؤَاجٌ» ، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّ ذَا لِكَذَا؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» ، قَالَ عُبَادَةُ: فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لَا أَعْمَلُ عَمَلًا عَلَى اثْنَيْنِ أَبَدًا
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibn Tawus narrated to us, from his father, who said
entries.matn_en: [p. 142]: The Messenger of God ﷺ appointed 'Ubada b. al-Samit over the alms and then said to him: “Beware, Abu al-Walid, lest you come on the Day of Resurrection carrying on your neck a roaring camel, a lowing cow, or a bleating sheep.” He asked: “Messenger of God, will that really happen?” He replied: “Yes.” 'Ubada said: “By the One who sent you with the truth, I will never again assume authority over even two people.”

sections.title_en: Report of Jābir ibn Samura al-Suwāʾī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ السُّوَائِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْقِبْطِيَّةِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا نُصَلَّيْ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ أَحَدُنَا رَمَى بِيَدِهِ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ هَكَذَا: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا بَالَكُمْ تَرْمُونَ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ كَأَنَّهَا أَذْنَابُ خَيْلٍ شُمْسٍ، أَوَلَا يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ، أَوْ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْ يَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى فَخِذِهِ، ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَى أَخِيهِ مِنْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَمِنْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Ibn al-Qibtiyya, from Jabir b. Samura, who said:
entries.matn_en: We used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ. When one of us gave the salutation, he would fling his hand to the right and left like this, saying: “Peace be upon you, peace be upon you.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Why do you throw your hands about as though they were the tails of restive horses? Is it not enough for one of you—or one of you need only—place his hand on his thigh, then salute his brother to his right and left: ‘Peace be upon you and God’s mercy, peace be upon you and God’s mercy’?”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Azhar ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَزْهَرَ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَزْهَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جُرِحَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ، فَمَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا غُلَامٌ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ يَدُلُّ عَلَى رَحْلِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ» ، فَخَرَجْتُ أَسْعى بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَأَنَا أَقُولُ: مَنْ يَدُلُّ عَلَى رَحْلِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَى رَحْلٍ قَدْ أَصَابَتْهُ جِرَاحَةٌ فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهُ وَدَعَا لَهُ، قَالَ: «وَأَرَى فِيهِ وَنَفَثَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ma'mar narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Azhar, who said:
entries.matn_en: Khalid b. al-Walid was wounded on the day of Hunayn. The Messenger of God ﷺ passed me while I was a boy, saying: “Who can guide me to Khalid b. al-Walid’s lodging?” I ran ahead of the Messenger of God ﷺ, calling: “Who can guide us to Khalid b. al-Walid’s lodging?” until the Messenger of God ﷺ reached him, leaning against his baggage, wounded. The Messenger of God ﷺ sat by him and prayed for him; and, I believe, he blew [lightly] upon him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدِيثُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ رضي الله عنه 922 - حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ بِأَحَادِيثَ فِيمَا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ، مِنْهَا مَنْ قَالَ: يَتَوَضَّأُ، وَمِنْهَا مَنْ قَالَ: لَا يَتَوَضَّأُ، فَاخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَيَّ، فَكَانَ مِمَّنْ قَالَ: «الْوُضُوءُ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ» ، أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، وَأُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us a number of reports about [food] touched by fire, some of which said ablution is required and others that it is not, and they became confused in my memory. Among those who reported that “ablution is required after [eating] what fire has touched” were Abu Salama, 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, and Umm Habiba, transmitting from the Prophet ﷺ; Abu Hurayra, transmitting from the Prophet ﷺ; and Zayd b. Thabit, transmitting from the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَحَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَزَّ كَتِفَ شَاةٍ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ» ⦗ص: 146⦘ ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: «أَكَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَحْمًا، وَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ» ، لَا أَشَكُّ أَنَّ الزُّهْرِيَّ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْهُمَا، إِنَّمَا أَشُكُّ لِأَنِّي لَا أَعْرِفُ حَدِيثَ ذَا مِنْ حَدِيثِ ذَا " قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَكَانَ الزُّهْرِيُّ «يَتَوَضَّأُ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan said: Al-Zuhri narrated to us: 'Ali b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas informed me, from his father, and Ja'far b. 'Amr b. Umayya al-Damri, from his father:
entries.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ cut meat from a sheep’s shoulder and ate some of it, then stood to pray and prayed without performing ablution.” [p. 146] The other said: “The Prophet ﷺ ate meat and prayed without performing ablution.” I have no doubt that al-Zuhri narrated from both of them; my only uncertainty is which hadith belongs to which transmitter. Sufyan said: Al-Zuhri himself used to perform ablution after eating food touched by fire.

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaʿmar al-Dīlī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْمَرَ الدِّيلِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الثَّوْرِيُّ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَهَذَا أَجْوَدُ شَيْءٍ وَجَدْنَاهُ عِنْدَهُ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْمَرَ الدِّيلِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «الْحَجُّ عَرَفَاتٌ، مَنْ أَدْرَكَ عَرَفَةَ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْحَجَّ، أَيَّامُ مِنًى ثَلَاثَةٌ فَمَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ، وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Sufyan b. Sa'id al-Thawri narrated to us.
entries.matn_en: Sufyan [ibn 'Uyayna] said: “This is the best-preserved account that we found with him.” He said: Bukayr b. 'Ata' al-Laythi informed me, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ya'mar al-Dili, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “Pilgrimage is 'Arafat. Whoever reaches 'Arafa before dawn has attained the pilgrimage. The days of Mina are three; whoever hastens away after two days incurs no sin, and whoever delays incurs no sin.”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿUrwa ibn Muḍarris ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ لَامٍ الطَّائِيَّ، قَالَ: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُ مِنْ جَبَلَيْ طَيِّئٍ وَاللَّهِ مَا جِئْتُ حَتَّى أَتْعَبَتُ نَفْسِي وَأَنْضَيْتُ رَاحِلَتِي، وَمَا تَرَكْتُ جَبَلًا إِلَّا وَقَفْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَنَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ وَقَدْ كَانَ وَقَفَ بِعَرَفَةَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارَا فَقَدْ تَمٌّ حَجُّهُ وَقَضَى تَفَثَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Isma'il b. Abi Khalid narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Urwa b. Mudarris b. Aws b. Haritha b. Lam al-Ta'i say: I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ at Muzdalifa and said: “Messenger of God, I have come from the two mountains of Tayyi'. By God, I did not arrive until I had exhausted myself and worn out my mount; I left no mountain without stopping upon it.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever witnesses this prayer with us and has already stood at 'Arafa by night or by day has completed his pilgrimage and fulfilled his rites.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَكَانَ أَحْفَظَهُمَا لِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ لَامٍ الطَّائِيَّ، يَقُولُ: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَيْتُكَ السَّاعَةَ مِنْ جَبَلَيْ طَيِّئٍ قَدْ أَكْلَلْتُ رَاحِلَتِي، وَأَتْعَبْتُ نَفْسِي، فَهَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَنَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ، وَوَقَفَ مَعَنَا حَتَّى يُفِيضَ، وَقَدْ كَانَ وَقَفَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ بِعَرَفَةَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا، فَقَدْ تَمَّ حَجُّهُ وَقَضَى تَفَثَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: Zakariyya b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us—he was the more accurate of the two in preserving this report—from al-Sha'bi, who said: I heard 'Urwa b. Mudarris b. Aws b. Haritha b. Lam al-Ta'i say: I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ at Muzdalifa and said: “Messenger of God, I have just come from the two mountains of Tayyi', having exhausted my mount and myself. Do I have a pilgrimage?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Whoever witnesses this prayer with us and stands with us until we depart, having stood at 'Arafa before that by night or by day, has completed his pilgrimage and fulfilled his rites.”

sections.title_en: Report of Surāqa ibn Mālik ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ سُرَاقَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُخْبِرُ، عَنِ ابْنِ سُرَاقَةَ أَوِ ابِنْ أَخِي سُرَاقَةَ، عَنْ سُرَاقَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ، فَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْهُ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَمْلَأُ حَوْضِي، أَنْتَظِرُ ظَهْرِي يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ، فَتَجِيءَ الْبُهْمَةُ فَتَشْرَبُ، فَهَلْ لِي فِي ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَكَ فِي كُلِّ كَبِدٍ حَرَّى أَجْرٌ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: هَذَا الَّذِي حَفِظْتُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، وَاخْتَلَطَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ شَيْءٌ فَأَخْبَرَنِي وَائِلُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ بَعْضَ هَذَا الْكَلَامِ لَا أُخْلِصُ مَا حَفِظْتُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، وَمَا أَخْبَرَنِيهِ وَائِلٌ، قَالَ سُرَاقَةُ: أَتَيْتُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ، فَجَعَلْتُ لَا أَمُرُّ عَلَى مِقْنَبٍ مِنْ مَقَانِبِ الْأَنْصَارِ إِلَّا قَرَعُوا رَأْسِي، وَقَالُوا إِلَيْكَ إِلَيْكَ، فَلَمَّا انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَيْهِ رَفَعْتُ الْكِتَابَ، وَقُلْتُ: أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: وَقَدْ كَانَ كَتَبَ لِي أَمَانًا فِي رُقْعَةٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «نَعَمْ، الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ وَفَاءٍ وَبِرٍّ وَصِدْقٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri narrate, from the son of Suraqa—or the nephew of Suraqa—from Suraqa, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ at al-Ji'rana and did not know what to ask. I said: “Messenger of God, I fill my watering trough, waiting for my riding animals to come and drink, and a young sheep comes and drinks from it. Is there a reward for me in that?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “You have a reward for every thirsty living creature.” Sufyan said: “This is what I remembered from al-Zuhri, but some of the beginning became confused for me. Wa'il b. Dawud told me some of this from al-Zuhri, and I cannot distinguish precisely what I remembered directly from al-Zuhri from what Wa'il told me.” Suraqa said: “I came to the Prophet of God ﷺ while he was at al-Ji'rana. Whenever I passed a contingent of the Helpers, they struck my head and said: ‘Keep away! Keep away!’ When I reached him, I held up the document and said: ‘It is I, Messenger of God.’” He said that the Prophet ﷺ had written him a promise of safety on a piece of writing material. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Yes. Today is a day of loyalty, righteousness, and truthfulness.”

sections.title_en: Report of Ibn Buḥayna ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْأَعْرَجَ، يُحُدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَاةً أَظُنُّ أَنَّهَا الْعَصْرُ، فَقَامَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، وَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي آخِرِ صَلَاتِهِ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ» .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: I heard al-A'raj narrate from Ibn Buhayna, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ led us in a prayer—I think it was 'Asr—and rose after the second rak'a without sitting. At the end of the prayer, he performed two prostrations before giving the salutation.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، بِمِثْلِهِ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «فَقَامَ فِي الَّتِي يُسْتَرَاحُ فِيهَا» وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ابْنُ بُحَيْنَةَ، وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَالِكِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Yahya b. Sa'id narrated to us, from al-A'raj, from Ibn Buhayna, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same, except that
entries.matn_en: he said: “He rose during the [sitting] in which one should rest.” Sufyan sometimes said “'Abd Allah b. Buhayna” and at other times “'Abd Allah b. Malik b. Buhayna.”

sections.title_en: Two reports of ʿUthmān ibn Abī al-ʿĀṣ ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثَا عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ قال: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَهُ مِنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدَ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أُمَّ قَوْمَكَ وَاقْدُرْهُمْ بِأَضْعَفِهِمْ، فَإِنَّ مِنْهُمُ الْكَبِيرَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad b. Ishaq narrated to us, having heard it from Sa'id ibn Abi Hind, who heard it from Mutarrif b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Shikhkhir, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard 'Uthman b. Abi al-'As al-Thaqafi say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Lead your people in prayer, taking account of the weakest among them; among them are the elderly, the weak, and those with needs.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَاتَّخِذْ مُؤَذِّنًا لَا يَأْخُذُ عَلَى أَذَانِهِ أَجْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: al-Fudayl b. 'Iyad narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, from 'Uthman b. Abi al-'As, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: “Appoint a caller to prayer who takes no payment for his call.”

sections.title_en: Report of Burayda al-Aslamī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ بُرَيْدَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُعْتِبٌ التَّمِيمِيُّ وَكَانَ ثِقَةً خِيَارًا، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " حُرْمَةُ نِسَاءِ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ عَلَى الْقَاعِدِينَ فِي الْحُرْمَةِ كَأُمَّهَاتِهِمْ، وَمَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَاعِدِينَ يَخْلُفُ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ فِي أَهْلِهِ، فَيْخَبِّبُ فِي أَهْلِهِ إِلَّا نُصِبَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ: يَا فُلَانُ هَذَا فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ خَانَكَ، فَخُذْ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ "، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ؟»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mu'tib al-Tamimi, who was trustworthy and upright, narrated to us, from 'Alqama b. Marthad, from Sulayman b. Burayda, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The wives of those who strive in God’s cause have the same inviolability for those who remain behind as their own mothers. If a man who remains behind is entrusted with the household of an emigrant fighting in God’s cause and corrupts it, he will be brought forth for him on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said: ‘So-and-so, this is so-and-so son of so-and-so; he betrayed you. Take as many of his good deeds as you wish.’” Then the Messenger of God ﷺ turned toward us and said: “What do you think [will be left of his good deeds]?”

sections.title_en: Reports of Abū Umāma al-Bāhilī ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو غَالِبٍ صَاحِبُ الْمِحْجَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيَّ أَبْصَرَ رُءُوسَ خَوَارِجَ عَلَى دَرَجِ دِمَشْقٍ، فَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «كِلَابُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، كِلَابُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، كِلَابُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ» ، ثُمَّ بَكَى، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «شَرُّ قَتْلَى تَحْتَ أَدِيمِ السَّمَاءِ، وَخَيْرُ قَتْلَى مَنْ قَتَلُوا» قَالَ أَبُو غَالِبٍ: أَأَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، إِنِّي إِذَنْ لَجُرِئٌ، سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، غَيْرَ مَرَّةٍ وَلَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَا ثَلَاثٍ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Ghalib, the man with the hooked staff, narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I saw Abu Umama al-Bahili look at the heads of Kharijites displayed on the steps in Damascus. He said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “Dogs of the people of the Fire! Dogs of the people of the Fire! Dogs of the people of the Fire!” Then he wept and said: “The worst of those killed beneath the sky, and the best of those killed are the people whom they killed.” Abu Ghalib asked: “Did you yourself hear this from the Messenger of God ﷺ?” He replied: “Yes. I would be very audacious indeed if I had not heard it from the Messenger of God ﷺ—not just once or twice or three times.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُطَرَّحٌ أَبُو الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَغْبَطُ أَوْلِيَائِي عِنْدِي مَنْزِلَةً رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ خَفِيفُ الْحَاذِ ذُو حَظٍّ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ غَامِضًا فِي النَّاسِ، فَعَجَّلْتُ مَنِيَّتَهُ، وَقَلَّتْ بَواكِيهِ، وَقَلَّ تُرَاثُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mutarrah Abu al-Muhallab narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Zahr, from al-Qasim Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Umama, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The one of my close followers whose station I most envy is a believing man with few possessions, who has a share in prayer and is inconspicuous among people. I hasten his death, few are those who mourn him, and little is his inheritance.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُطَرَّحٌ أَبُو الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَحِلُّ ثَمَنُ الْمُغَنِّيَةِ، وَلَا بَيْعُهَا، وَلَا شِرَاؤُهَا، وَلَا الِاسْتِمَاعُ إِلَيْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mutarrah Abu al-Muhallab narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Zahr, from al-Qasim Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Umama, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The price of a singing slave woman is not lawful, nor her sale, nor her purchase, nor listening to her.”

sections.title_en: Report of Bilāl ibn al-Ḥārith al-Muzanī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ بِلَالِ بْنِ حَارِثٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ بِلَالِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الْمُزَنِيِّ يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الرَّجُلُ لَيْتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ سَخَطِ اللَّهِ مَا يَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبْلُغَ مَا تَبْلُغُ، فَيَكْتُبُ اللَّهُ بِهَا سَخَطَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيْتَكَلَّمَ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ مَا يَظُنُّ أَنْ تَبْلُغَ مَا بَلَغَتْ، فَيَكْتُبُ اللَّهُ بِهَا رِضَاهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ» ، قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: «هَذَا مَا عِنْدِي يَبْلُغُ بِهِ كَمَا كَانَ يَقُولُهُ أَوَّلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Alqama al-Laythi narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, from Bilal b. al-Harith al-Muzani,
entries.matn_en: tracing it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “A man may speak a word that incurs God’s displeasure, not imagining how far it will reach, and God will record His displeasure against him until the Day of Resurrection. And a man may speak a word that earns God’s pleasure, not imagining how far it will reach, and God will record His pleasure with him until the Day of Resurrection.” Al-Humaydi said: “This is what I have of the wording ‘tracing it to [the Prophet],’ as he used to say at first.”

sections.title_en: Report of Iyās ibn ʿAbd al-Muzanī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الْمِنْهَالِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْمُزَنِيَّ،
entries.matn_ar: وَرَأَى أُنَاسًا يَبِيعُونَ الْمَاءَ، فَقَالَ: لَا تَبِيعُوا الْمَاءَ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَنْهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمَاءِ» قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ: «وَلَا أَدْرِي أَيَّ مَاءٍ هُوَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: 'Amr b. Dinar narrated to us, saying: Abu al-Minhal informed me, saying: I heard Iyas b. 'Abd al-Muzani, when he saw some people selling water, say:
entries.matn_en: “Do not sell water, for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ forbid the sale of water.” 'Amr b. Dinar said: “I do not know what kind of water was meant.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: «هُوَ عِنْدَنَا أَنْ يُبَاعَ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَهُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ» ، وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ: «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ نَقْعِ الْبِيرِ»
entries.matn_en: Sufyan said: “In our understanding, it means selling water in the place where God caused it to emerge.” It has also been reported from the Prophet ﷺ that “he forbade selling the water collected in a well.”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim al-Ṭāʾī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمِ الطَّائِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ، قَالَ: «لَا تَأْكُلْ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Zakariyya b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about game struck by a mi'rad [a broad-headed hunting implement]. He replied: “Do not eat it unless you have ritually slaughtered it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ، فَقَالَ: «مَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْ، وَمَا أَصَابَ بِعُرْضِهِ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ، فَإِنَّهُ وَقِيذٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mujalid narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about game struck by a mi'rad. He replied: “Eat what it strikes with its sharp edge, but do not eat what it strikes with its broad side, for it is an animal killed by a blow.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ ⦗ص: 161⦘ ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «كَيْفَ بِكَ إِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الظَّعِينَةُ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْيَمَنِ إِلَى قُصُورِ الْحِيرَةِ لَا تَخَافُ إِلَّا اللَّهَ» ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَكَيْفَ بِطَيِّئٍ مَقَانِبِهَا وَرِجَالِهَا، قَالَ: «يَكْفِيهَا اللَّهُ طَيِّئًا وَمَنْ سِوَاهَا» قَالَ مُجَالِدٌ: «فَلَقَدْ كَانَتِ الظَّعِينَةُ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ حَضْرَمَوْتَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ الْحِيرَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mujalid narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “How will it be for you when a woman traveling in a litter comes from the farthest part of Yemen to the palaces of al-Hira, fearing none but God?” I said: “Messenger of God, what about the armed bands and men of Tayyi'?” He said: “God will suffice her against Tayyi' and all others.” Mujalid said: “Indeed, a woman in a litter would set out from Hadramawt and reach al-Hira.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الصَّوْمِ؟ فَقَالَ: «حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ» قَالَ عَدِيٌّ: فَأَخَذْتُ عِقَالَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْيَضُ وَالْآخَرُ أَسْوَدُ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: شَيْئًا لَمْ أَحْفَظْهُ، وَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا هُوَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ» فَقِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ: سَمِعْتَ هَذَا عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ؟ ⦗ص: 162⦘ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، وَكَانَ يُحْسِنُهُ وَلَكِنِّي لَمْ أَحْفَظْهُ كُلَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about fasting, and he said: “Until the white thread becomes distinguishable from the black thread.” 'Adi said: “So I took two cords, one white and one black, and kept looking at them.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said something which Sufyan said he had not retained, then said: “It means night and day.” Sufyan was asked [p. 162]: “Did you hear this from Mujalid?” He replied: “Yes. He narrated it well, but I did not memorize all of it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ الْمُعَلَّمِ، فَقَالَ: «إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَكُلْ مِمَّا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ، فَإِنْ أَكَلَ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ، فَإِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ» ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ خَالَطَتْ كِلَابَنَا كِلَابٌ أُخْرَى، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Adi b. Hatim, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about game caught by a trained dog. He said: “When you send your dog and mention God’s name, eat what it catches for you. But if it eats from it, do not eat, for it caught it for itself.” I asked: “Messenger of God, what if other dogs mix with ours?” He replied: “You mentioned God’s name only over your own dog.”

sections.title_en: Reports of al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو فَرْوَةَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَلَالٌ بَيِّنٌ وَحَرَامٌ بَيِّنٌ، وَشُبُهَاتٌ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، فَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَا اشْتَبَهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ كَانَ لِمَا اسْتَبَانَ لَهُ أَتْرَكَ، وَمَنِ اجْتَرَأَ عَلَى مَا شَكَّ فِيهِ، أَوْشَكَ أَنْ يُواقِعَ الْحَرَامَ، وَإِنَّ لِكُلٍ مَلِكٍ حِمًى، وَحِمَى اللَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَعَاصِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Farwa al-Hamdani narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard al-Sha'bi say: I heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir say from the pulpit: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “The lawful is clear and the forbidden is clear, with doubtful matters between them. Whoever abandons what is doubtful to him through fear of sin will be even more likely to abandon what is clearly sinful. Whoever dares to do what he doubts is close to falling into the forbidden. Every king has a protected domain, and God’s protected domain on earth consists of His prohibitions.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا مُجَالِدٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ: وَكُنْتُ إِذَا سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ظَنَنْتُ أَنِّي لَا ⦗ص: 164⦘ أَسْمَعُ أَحَدًا بَعْدَهُ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ: «مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَبَاذُلِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ، كَمَثَلِ الْإِنْسَانِ، إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوٌ مِنْ أَعْضَائِهِ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالْحُمَّى وَالسَّهَرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Mujalid narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Sha'bi say: I heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir say: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ. Al-Sha'bi said:
entries.matn_en: “Whenever I heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir on the pulpit saying ‘I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ,’ I thought I would never hear another person after him say ‘I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ.’” He then said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “The likeness of the believers in their generosity toward one another, their affection, and their mercy is like a human being: when one of his limbs suffers, the whole body responds with fever and sleeplessness.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «فِي الْإِنْسَانِ مُضْغَةٌ، إِذَا هِيَ صَلُحَتْ وَسَلِمَتْ سَلِمَ لَهَا سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ، وَصَحَّ، وَإِذَا هِيَ سَقِمَتْ سَقِمَ لَهَا سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ وَفَسَدَ، وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ»
entries.matn_en: He said [continuing the preceding report from al-Nu'man b. Bashir]: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “In the human being there is a morsel of flesh; when it is sound and healthy, all the body is sound and healthy, and when it is ill, all the body falls ill and is corrupted. It is the heart.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَثَلُ الْمُدْهِنُ فِي حُقُوقِ اللَّهِ وَالْوَاقِعِ فِيهَا، وَالْقَائِمِ عَلَيْهَا، كَمَثَلِ ثَلَاثَةٍ رَكِبُوا سَفِينَةً وَاسْتَهَمُوا مَنَازِلَهَا، فَصَارَ لِأَحَدِهِمْ أَسْفَلُهَا وَأَوْعَرُهَا وَشَرُّهَا، وَكَانَ مُخْتَلَفُهُ وَمُهْرَاقُ مَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَبَيْنَا هُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُفْجَأُهُمْ بِهِ إِلَّا ⦗ص: 165⦘ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ الْقَدُومَ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ: أَيَّ شَيْءٍ تَصْنَعُ؟ فَقَالَ: أَخْرِقُ فِي حَقِّي خَرْقًا فَيَكُونُ أَقْرَبَ لِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ وَيَكُونَ فِيهِ مُخْتَلَفِي وَمُهْرَاقُ مَائِي، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ: اتْرُكُوهُ أَبْعَدَهُ اللَّهُ يَخْرِقُ فِي حَقِّهِ مَا شَاءَ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: لَا تَدَعُوهُ يَخْرِقُهَا، فَيَهْلِكُنَا وَيُهْلَكُ نَفْسَهُ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَخَذُوا عَلَى يَدَيْهِ نَجَا وَنَجَوْا مَعَهُ، وَإِنْ هُمْ لَمْ يَأْخُذُوا عَلَى يَدَيْهِ هَلَكَ وَهَلَكُوا مَعَهُ "
entries.matn_en: And I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say [continuing al-Nu'man’s reports]: “The likeness of one who compromises God’s rights, one who violates them, and one who upholds them is like three men who boarded a ship and drew lots for its places. One received the lowest, most difficult, and worst part, through which he had to pass and where he poured out his water. While they were aboard, they were startled to find him taking up an adze. They asked: ‘What are you doing?’ He replied: ‘I am making a hole in my own portion so that I can reach water more easily, and it can serve as my passageway and place for pouring water.’ Some said: ‘Leave him, may God cast him far away; he may make whatever hole he wishes in his own portion.’ Others said: ‘Do not allow him to make a hole, for he will destroy us and himself.’ If they restrain his hand, he is saved and they are saved with him. If they do not restrain his hand, he perishes and they perish with him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَلَالٌ بَيِّنٌ وَحَرَامٌ بَيِّنٌ، وَشُبُهَاتٌ بَيْنَ ذَاكَ، فَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَا اشْتَبَهَ عَلَيْهُ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ كَانَ لِمَا اسْتَبَانَ لَهُ أَتْرَكَ، وَمَنِ اجْتَرَأَ عَلَى مَا شَكَّ فِيهِ، يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُواقِعَ الْحَرَامَ، كَمَنْ رَتَعَ إِلَى جَانِبِ الْحِمَى، يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَقَعَ فِيهِ، وَإِنَّ لِكُلِ مَلِكٍ حِمًى، وَحِمَى اللَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَعَاصِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: He said [continuing al-Nu'man’s reports]: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: “The lawful is clear and the forbidden is clear, with doubtful matters between them. Whoever abandons what is doubtful to him through fear of sin will be even more likely to abandon what is clearly sinful. Whoever boldly approaches what he doubts is close to falling into the forbidden, like someone grazing beside a protected pasture, on the verge of entering it. Every king has a protected domain, and God’s protected domain on earth consists of His prohibitions.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: نَحَلَنِي أَبِي غُلَامًا، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ أُمِّي عَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ رَوَاحَةَ: إِيتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشْهِدْهُ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُشْهِدَهُ، فَقَالَ: «أَكَلَ وَلَدِكَ نَحَلْتَ مِثْلَ هَذَا؟» ، قَالَ: لَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنِّي لَا أَشْهَدُ إِلَّا عَلَى حَقٍّ» وَأَبَى أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: He said [continuing al-Sha'bi’s account]: I heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir say:
entries.matn_en: “My father gave me a slave boy as a gift. My mother 'Amra bint Rawaha told him: ‘Go to the Prophet ﷺ and ask him to witness it.’ He went to the Prophet ﷺ to make him a witness, but the Prophet asked: ‘Have you given all your children gifts like this?’ He said: ‘No.’ The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘I bear witness only to what is right,’ and refused to witness it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ -
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: كَانَ سُفْيَانُ يَغْلَطَ فِيهِ - «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْعِيدِ بِسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى، وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا إِذَا وَافَقَ ذَلِكَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. al-Muntashir narrated to us, from his father, from Habib b. Salim, from his father, from al-Nu'man b. Bashir—al-Humaydi said:
entries.matn_en: “Sufyan used to err in this chain”—that the Messenger of God ﷺ used to recite “Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High” [Q 87] and “Has the account of the Overwhelming reached you?” [Q 88] in the festival prayer, and he recited them in both prayers when the festival coincided with Friday.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ الضَّبِّيُّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمْ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَاهُ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid al-Dabbi narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. al-Muntashir, from his father, from Habib b. Salim, from al-Nu'man b. Bashir, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: a report with the same meaning. He did not include “from his father” [between Habib and al-Nu'man].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ نَحَلَهُ نَحْلًا، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُشْهِدَهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَكُلَّ وَلَدِكَ نَحَلْتَ مِثْلَ هَذَا» ، قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَارْدُدْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman and Muhammad b. al-Nu'man informed me that they both heard al-Nu'man b. Bashir relate
entries.matn_en: that his father gave him a gift and went to the Prophet ﷺ to have him witness it. The Prophet ﷺ asked: “Have you given each of your children the same?” He replied: “No.” He said: “Then take it back.”

sections.title_en: Report of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aqram al-Khuzāʿī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَقْرَمَ الْخُزَاعِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُفْيَانُ ثنا، قَالَ: ثنا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْفَرَّاءُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَقْرَمَ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْقَاعِ مِنْ نَمِرَةَ يُصَلِّي، فَرَأَيْتُ بَيَاضَ إِبِطَيْهِ إِذَا سَجَدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Dawud b. Qays al-Farra' narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. Aqram al-Khuza'i, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ praying on the level ground at Namira; I could see the whiteness of his armpits when he prostrated.”

sections.title_en: Reports of Sahl ibn Saʿd al-Sāʿidī ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: اطَّلَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُحْرٍ فِي حُجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِيَدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يَحُكُّ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ، فَقَالَ: «لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ لَطَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ، إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الِاسْتِيذَانُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: I heard Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi say:
entries.matn_en: A man peered through a hole into the Prophet’s ﷺ room while the Prophet ﷺ held a comb-like implement with which he was scratching his head. He said: “Had I known you were looking in, I would have stabbed you in the eye with it. Permission to enter was instituted because of looking.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَازِمٍ ⦗ص: 169⦘ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَذِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ» وَأَشَارَ سُفْيَانُ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ، وَالْوُسْطَى
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim narrated to us [p. 169], that he heard Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “I and the Hour were sent like this one and this one.” Sufyan gestured with his index and middle fingers.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ: سَأَلُوا سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ مِنْبَرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمَ بِهِ مِنِّي، هُوَ مِنْ أَثَلِ الْغَابَةِ، عَمِلَهِ لَهُ فُلَانٌ مَوْلَى فُلَانَةَ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «حِينَ صَعَدَ عَلَيْهِ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَكَبَّرَ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ الْقَهْقَرَى فَسَجَدَ، ثُمَّ صَعَدَ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ الْقَهْقَرَى، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim told us:
entries.matn_en: People asked Sahl b. Sa'd what the pulpit of the Messenger of God ﷺ had been made from. He said: “No one remains who knows more about it than I do. It was made from tamarisk wood from al-Ghaba; it was made for him by such-and-such a man, the freedman of a certain woman. I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ when he climbed it, faced the qibla and said the takbir, then recited and bowed. Then he stepped backward down from it and prostrated. Then he climbed up again, recited, bowed, stepped backward down, and prostrated.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَازِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 170⦘ : سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، يَقُولُ: خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ فِي شَيْءٍ وَقَعَ بَيْنَهُمْ حَتَّى تَرَامَوْا بِالْحِجَارَةِ، فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، وَاحْتُبِسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقَدَّمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَعَلَ يَتَخَلَّلُ الصُّفُوفَ، فَلَمَّا انْتَهَى إِلَى الصَّفِّ الَّذِي يَلِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَخَذَ النَّاسُ فِي التَّصْفِيحِ، وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَجُلًا لَا يَلْتَفِتُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ الْتَفَتَ، فَأَبْصَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اثْبُتْ، فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَرَجَعَ الْقَهْقَرَى، وَتَقَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَاتَهُ، فَقَالَ: «يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، مَا مَنَعَكَ حِينَ أَشَرْتُ إِلَيْكَ؟» ، فَقَالَ: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَرَى ابْنَ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ انْحَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى النَّاسِ، فَقَالَ: " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَا لَكَمْ حِينَ نَابَكُمْ فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ شَيْءٌ أَخَذْتُمْ فِي التَّصْفِيحِ، إِنَّمَا التَّصْفِيحُ لِلنِّسَاءِ، وَالتَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ، مَنْ نَابَهُ شَيْءٌ فِي صَلَاتِهِ، فَلْيَقُلْ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim narrated to us, saying
entries.matn_en: [p. 170]: I heard Sahl b. Sa'd say: The Messenger of God ﷺ went out to reconcile a dispute among Banu 'Amr b. 'Awf; they had even thrown stones at one another. When the time for prayer arrived, Bilal called the adhan, but the Messenger of God ﷺ was delayed, so Abu Bakr stepped forward to lead the people. The Messenger of God ﷺ then came and made his way between the rows. When he reached the row immediately behind Abu Bakr, the people began clapping. Abu Bakr was a man who did not turn around in prayer, but when he heard the clapping he turned and saw the Messenger of God ﷺ. The Messenger of God ﷺ signaled for him to remain in place. Abu Bakr raised his head toward heaven in thanks to God and stepped backward. The Messenger of God ﷺ came forward. When the Messenger of God ﷺ finished the prayer, he asked: “Abu Bakr, what prevented you from staying when I signaled to you?” He replied: “God would not see the son of Abu Quhafa standing ahead of the Messenger of God ﷺ.” The Messenger of God ﷺ then turned to the people and said: “People, why did you start clapping when something occurred during your prayer? Clapping is for women, and glorifying God is for men. Whoever encounters something during his prayer should say: ‘Glory be to God.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ فِي الْقَوْمِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ وَهَبْتُ نَفْسِي لَكَ، فَارْأَ فِيَّ رَأْيَكَ ⦗ص: 171⦘ ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: أَنْكِحْنِيهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ قَامَ، فَقَالَ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، لِلرَّجُلِ: «هَلْ عِنْدَكَ شَيْءٌ تُعْطِيهَا إِيَّاهُ؟» فَقَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَاذْهَبْ فَاطْلُبْ شَيْئًا» ، فَذَهَبَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: «اذْهَبْ فَاطْلُبْ وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ» ، فَذَهَبَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا وَلَا خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ شَيْءٌ؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ سُورَةُ كَذَا، وَسُورَةُ كَذَا، قَالَ: «فَاذْهَبَ فَقَدْ زَوَّجْتُكُهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim narrated to us, that he heard Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi say:
entries.matn_en: I was among the people with the Messenger of God ﷺ when a woman came to him and said: “Messenger of God, I have offered myself to you; decide concerning me as you see fit.” [p. 171] A man stood and said: “Marry her to me, Messenger of God, if you have no need of her.” The Messenger of God ﷺ remained silent. The man stood again and repeated his request. The Messenger of God ﷺ asked him: “Do you have anything to give her?” He said: “No.” He said: “Go and look for something.” The man went away and returned, saying: “Messenger of God, I found nothing.” He said: “Go and look, even if only for an iron ring.” The man went away and returned: “Messenger of God, I found nothing, not even an iron ring.” The Messenger of God ﷺ asked: “Do you know any of the Qur'an?” He said: “Yes, such-and-such a sura and such-and-such a sura.” He said: “Then go; I have married her to you for what you know of the Qur'an.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اخْتَلَفَ النَّاسُ بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ دُوِيَ جُرْحُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ؟ فَسَأَلُوا سَهْلًا، وَكَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ مَنْ بَقِيَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ ⦗ص: 172⦘ ، فَقَالَ: مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمَ بِهِ مِنِّي، «كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَغْسِلُ عَنْ وَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الدَّمَ، وَعَلِيٌّ يَأْتِي بِالْمَاءِ فِي تُرْسِهِ، فَأُخِذَ حَصِيرٌ فَأُحْرِقَ فَحُشِيَ بِهِ جُرْحُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: People disagreed about what had been used to treat the wound of the Messenger of God ﷺ on the day of Uhud. They asked Sahl, one of the last Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ remaining in Medina [p. 172]. He replied: “No one remains who knows it better than I do. Fatima was washing the blood from the face of the Messenger of God ﷺ, while 'Ali brought water in his shield. A mat was taken, burned, and its ashes pressed into his wound.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim narrated to us, from Sahl b. Sa'd, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The space occupied by a whip in Paradise is better than the world and everything in it.”

sections.title_en: Report of Qārib al-Thaqafī ؓ
sections.title_ar: حَدِيثُ قَارِبٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَارِبٍ، أَوْ مَارِبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حِجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «يُرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا، وَمَدَّ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ يَمِينَهُ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ، فَقَالَ: «يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ، فَقَالَ: «يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ، فَقَالَ: «وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ» وَأَشَارَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ بِيَدِهِ، فَلَمْ يَمُدَّ مِثْلَ الْأَوَّلِ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: " وَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَارِبٍ ⦗ص: 174⦘ ، وَحِفْظِي قَارِبٍ، وَالنَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ: قَارِبٌ كَمَا حَفِظْتُ، فَأَنَا أَقُولُ: قَارِبٌ، أَوْ مَارِبٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim b. Maysara narrated to us; Wahb b. 'Abd Allah b. Qarib—or Marib—informed me, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage say:
entries.matn_en: “May God have mercy on those who shave their heads,” and he gestured with his hand in this way. Al-Humaydi extended his right hand. They said: “Messenger of God, and those who trim their hair?” He said: “May God have mercy on those who shave their heads.” They said: “Messenger of God, and those who trim their hair?” He said: “May God have mercy on those who shave their heads.” They asked once more: “Messenger of God, and those who trim their hair?” He said: “And those who trim their hair,” and al-Humaydi gestured with his hand, but did not extend it as far as on the first occasion. Sufyan said: “I found in my book, from Ibrahim b. Maysara, from Wahb b. 'Abd Allah b. Marib [p. 174], though I remember Qarib, and people say Qarib, as I remember it. Thus I say Qarib or Marib.”

sections.title_en: Reports of Ibn Khanbash ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ ابْنِ خَنْبَشٍ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو يَزِيدَ الْأَوْدِيُّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ خَنْبَشٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «عُمْرَةٌ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ كَحِجَّةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Dawud b. Yazid Abu Yazid al-Awdi narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Ibn Khanbash, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “An 'umra in the month of Ramadan is like a pilgrimage.”

sections.title_en: Reports of Abū Hurayra ؓ
sections.title_ar: أَحَادِيثُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا أَمَّنَ الْقَارِئُ فَأَمِّنُوا، فَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تُؤَمِّنُ، فَمَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us; Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “When the reciter says Amin, say Amin, for the angels say Amin. Whoever says it in agreement with the angels is forgiven his preceding sins.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ وَحَفِظْتُهُ مِنْهُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ، كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَكْتُبُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ، الْأَوَّلَ فَالْأَوَّلَ، فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الْإِمَامُ طُوِيَتِ الصُّحُفُ، وَاسْتَمَعُوا الْخُطْبَةَ، فَالْمُهَجِّرُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَدَنَةً، ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَقَرَةُ، ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي كَبْشًا، حَتَّى ذَكَرَ الدَّجَاجَةَ وَالْبَيْضَةَ» ⦗ص: 176⦘ ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: فَقِيلَ لِسُفْيَانَ: إِنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: مَا سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، ذَكَرَ الْأَغَرَّ قَطُّ، مَا سَمِعْتُهُ إِلَّا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri and memorized this directly from him, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, who informed him, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “On Friday, angels stand at every door of the mosque, recording people in the order of their arrival, one after another. When the imam comes out, the scrolls are rolled up and they listen to the sermon. The earliest arrival for Friday prayer is like someone offering a sacrificial camel; the next is like someone offering a cow; the next is like someone offering a ram,” and he went on to mention a chicken and an egg. [p. 176] Abu Bakr [al-Humaydi] said: Sufyan was asked: “They say this report goes through al-Agharr from Abu Hurayra.” Sufyan said: “I never heard al-Zuhri mention al-Agharr. I only heard it from Sa'id, who reported it from Abu Hurayra.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا أَتَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَلَا تَأْتُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْعَونَ، وَإِيتُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ تَمْشُونَ وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةُ، فَمَا أَدْرَكْتُمْ فَصَلُّوا، وَمَا فَاتَكَمْ فَاقْضُوا»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us: I heard al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “When you come to prayer, do not come running. Come walking in a composed manner. Pray what you catch of it, and make up what you have missed.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ، أَوْ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ: الْخِتَانُ، وَالِاسْتِحْدَادُ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الْأَظْفَارِ، وَنَتْفُ الْإِبِطِ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: I heard al-Zuhri say: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Five practices are part of the natural disposition (fitra), or five are among its practices: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, trimming the nails, plucking the armpit hair, and trimming the moustache.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيُصَلِّي أَحَدُنَا فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَوَلِكُلِّكُمْ ثَوْبَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Zuhri narrate from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man stood and asked the Prophet ﷺ: “May one of us pray in a single garment?” The Prophet ﷺ replied: “Does every one of you have two garments?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ لِرَجُلٍ يَسْأَلُهُ: «أَتَعْرِفُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ يُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَإِنَّ ثِيَابَهُ مَوضُوعَةٌ عَلَى الْمِشْجَبِ»
entries.matn_en: And Abu Hurayra said to a man who asked him: “Do you know Abu Hurayra? He prays in a single garment even though his clothes are hanging on a rack.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ كَمَا أَقُولُ لَكَ لَا نَحْتَاجُ فِيهِ إِلَى أَحَدٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ الْمَسْجِدَ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ، قَالَ: فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ، قَالَ: اللَّهُمُّ ارْحَمْنِي وَمُحَمَّدًا، وَلَا تَرْحَمْ مَعَنَا أَحَدًا، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: «لَقَدْ تَحَجَّرْتَ وَاسِعًا» ، فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ بَالَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَسْرَعَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَهْرِيقُوا عَلَيْهِ سَجْلًا مِنْ مَاءٍ، أَوْ دَلْوًا مِنْ مَاءٍ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُمْ مُيَسِّرِينَ، وَلَمْ تُبْعَثُوا مُعَسِّرِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: al-Zuhri narrated to us—and I tell you this without any need for another source—saying: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, from Abu Hurayra, who said: A Bedouin entered the mosque while the Prophet ﷺ was sitting. He stood and prayed. When he finished, he said: “O God, have mercy on me and Muhammad, and on nobody else alongside us.” The Messenger of God ﷺ turned to him and said: “You have restricted something vast.” Soon after that the Bedouin urinated in the mosque. The people rushed toward him, but the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Pour a bucketful of water over it.” Then he said: “You have been sent to make things easy, not to make them difficult.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَحَفِظْتُهُ مِنْهُ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: لَمَّا رَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ ⦗ص: 179⦘ ، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَعَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ بِمَكَّةَ، اللَّهُمُّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ، وَاجْعَلْهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: al-Zuhri narrated to us—and I memorized it from him—saying: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, from Abu Hurayra, who said: When the Messenger of God ﷺ raised his head from the last bowing of the morning prayer [p. 179], he said: “O God, rescue al-Walid b. al-Walid, Salama b. Hisham, 'Ayyash b. Abi Rabi'a, and the oppressed in Mecca. O God, tighten Your grip upon Mudar, and make their years like the years of Joseph.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers in any other mosque, except the Sacred Mosque.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا زِيَادُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَتِيقٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ ⦗ص: 180⦘ : «صَلَاةٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ مِائَةِ صَلَاةٍ، فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ» قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: «فَيَرَوْنَ أَنَّ الصَّلَاةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ مِائَةِ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلَّا مَسْجِدَ الرَّسُولِ، فَإِنَّمَا فَضْلُهُ عَلَيْهِ بِمِائَةِ صَلَاةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Ziyad b. Sa'd narrated to us, saying: Sulayman b. 'Atiq informed me, saying: I heard Ibn al-Zubayr say
entries.matn_en: from the pulpit [p. 180]: “A prayer in the Sacred Mosque is superior to a hundred prayers in other mosques.” Al-Humaydi said: Sufyan said: “They therefore consider that a prayer in the Sacred Mosque is superior to a hundred thousand prayers in other mosques except the Messenger’s Mosque, over which its superiority is only by a hundred prayers.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا اشْتَدَّ الْحَرُّ فَأَبْرِدُوا بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَإِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ» ،
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, saying: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, from Abu Hurayra, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “When the heat grows intense, delay the prayer until it is cooler, for intense heat comes from the scorching breath of Hell.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ: " اشْتَكَتِ النَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهَا، فَقَالَتْ: رَبِّ أَكَلَ بَعْضِي بَعْضًا، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا بِنَفَسَيْنِ، نَفَسٌ فِي الشِّتَاءِ، وَنَفَسٌ فِي الصَّيْفِ، فَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ حَرِّهَا، وَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الْبَرْدِ فَمِنْ زَمْهَرِيرِهَا "
entries.matn_en: And he [the Messenger of God ﷺ] said: “The Fire complained to its Lord, saying, ‘My Lord, one part of me has consumed another.’ So He permitted it two breaths: one in winter and one in summer. The most intense heat you experience is from its heat, and the most intense cold you experience is from its bitter cold (zamharir).” [This report continues the chain of no. 971: al-Humaydi ← Sufyan ← al-Zuhri ← Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib ← Abu Hurayra.]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ، إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِي هَذَا، وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Journeys should not be undertaken [for worship at a mosque] except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque, this mosque of mine, and al-Masjid al-Aqsa.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ: ثني يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ⦗ص: 182⦘ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي بُصْرَةُ بْنُ أَبِي بُصْرَةَ الْغِفَارِيُّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا تُعْمَلُ الْمَطِيُّ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ، إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِي هَذَا، وَمَسْجِدِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Abi Hazim narrated to us, saying: Yazid b. 'Abd Allah b. Usama b. al-Had narrated to me, from Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Taymi, from Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman [p. 182], from Abu Hurayra, who said: Busra b. Abi Busra al-Ghifari informed me that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Mounts should not be made to travel except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque, this mosque of mine, and the mosque of Bayt al-Maqdis.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَالَ: ثنا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ: ثنا الزُّهْرِيُّ،
entries.matn_ar: عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، إِمَّا سَعِيدٌ، وَإِمَّا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، وَأَكْثَرُ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: " أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمِ يُعْطَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ قَبْلِي: جُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ كُلُّهَا مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا، وَنُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ، وَأُحِلَّتْ لِي الْغَنَائِمُ ⦗ص: 184⦘ ، وَأُرْسِلْتُ إِلَى الْأَحْمَرِ وَالْأَسْوَدِ، وَأُعْطِيتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: al-Zuhri narrated to us, from someone who heard Abu Hurayra—either Sa'id or Abu Salama; most often he related it from Abu Hurayra—that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
